# SYNESIS_E018 — Error

## Description

Bundle `example_a, example_b` declared with only one field in the template.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The bundle `example_a, example_b` in the template was declared with only one field.
  A bundle needs at least two fields — it exists to ensure that
  related information always appears together.
  This problem is in the template definition. If you are not the author
  of the template, tell the project coordinator.
  Add the other fields to the bundle or remove the BUNDLE declaration,
  making the field simply REQUIRED or OPTIONAL.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **SingleFieldBundle**: `bundle_fields`
